 """Request handlers. Handlers receive untrusted params and call app.services only."""
 
+import ast
 from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_filter_users(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    if "where" not in params or not isinstance(params["where"], str):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid filter"}
+    
+    where = params["where"]
+    try:
+        tree = ast.parse(where, mode='eval')
+    except SyntaxError:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid filter"}
+    
+    if not _validate_node(tree.body):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid filter"}
+        
+    all_users = users.get_all_users()
+    filtered_users = []
+    try:
+        for user in all_users:
+            if _evaluate_node(tree.body, user):
+                filtered_users.append(user)
+    except Exception:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid filter"}
+    
+    filtered_users.sort(key=lambda u: u["id"])
+    return 200, {"users": filtered_users}
+
+
+def _validate_node(node):
+    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
+        return isinstance(node.value, (int, str)) and not isinstance(node.value, bool)
+    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
+        return node.id in ['id', 'name', 'email']
+    if isinstance(node, ast.Compare):
+        for op in node.ops:
+            if not isinstance(op, (ast.Eq, ast.NotEq, ast.Lt, ast.LtE, ast.Gt, ast.GtE)):
+                return False
+        return _validate_node(node.left) and all(_validate_node(n) for n in node.comparators)
+    if isinstance(node, ast.BoolOp):
+        return all(_validate_node(n) for n in node.values)
+    if isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
+        return isinstance(node.op, ast.Not) and _validate_node(node.operand)
+    return False
+
+
+def _evaluate_node(node, user):
+    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
+        return node.value
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.Name):
+        return user[node.id]
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.Compare):
+        left = _evaluate_node(node.left, user)
+        for i, op in enumerate(node.ops):
+            right = _evaluate_node(node.comparators[i], user)
+            
+            if isinstance(op, ast.Eq): res = (left == right)
+            elif isinstance(op, ast.NotEq): res = (left != right)
+            elif isinstance(op, ast.Lt): res = (left < right)
+            elif isinstance(op, ast.LtE): res = (left <= right)
+            elif isinstance(op, ast.Gt): res = (left > right)
+            elif isinstance(op, ast.GtE): res = (left >= right)
+            else: raise ValueError()
+            
+            if not res: return False
+            left = right
+        return True
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.BoolOp):
+        if isinstance(node.op, ast.And):
+            return all(_evaluate_node(v, user) for v in node.values)
+        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Or):
+            return any(_evaluate_node(v, user) for v in node.values)
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
+        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Not):
+            return not _evaluate_node(node.operand, user)
+    raise ValueError("Unsupported node")
